//go:build js && wasm

package client

import (
 "syscall/js"
 "testing"
)

// SOURCE ONLY: these tests have not been formatted, parsed, compiled or run.
// Fake claims below prove optional failure handling only. Actual native
// positives are isolated in the explicitly unadmitted native-browser file.
func offlineNativeTestClaimSlot(t *testing.T, next js.Value) {
 t.Helper()
 g:=js.Global()
 object:=checkedJSGet(g,"Object")
 descriptorFunction:=checkedJSGet(object,"getOwnPropertyDescriptor")
 old:=checkedJSInvoke(descriptorFunction,g,"__nextgoOfflineNativeClaimV1")
 checkedJSDefineData(g,"__nextgoOfflineNativeClaimV1",next)
 t.Cleanup(func(){
  if old.IsUndefined() {
   checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSGet(checkedJSGet(g,"Reflect"),"deleteProperty"),g,"__nextgoOfflineNativeClaimV1")
  } else {
   checkedJSInvoke(checkedJSReflection.defineProperty,g,"__nextgoOfflineNativeClaimV1",old)
  }
 })
}
func TestOfflineNativeMissingClaimIsOptional(t *testing.T) {
 offlineNativeTestClaimSlot(t,js.Undefined())
 if claimOfflineNativeCapability().valid {t.Fatal("missing claim became supported")}
 // Existing generic interop remains usable when this optional claim is absent.
 a:=checkedJSArray([]any{"ordinary",7,true})
 if checkedJSLength(a)!=3 || checkedJSIndex(a,0).String()!="ordinary" {t.Fatal("ordinary core interop failed")}
}
func TestOfflineNativeThrowingClaimIsOptional(t *testing.T) {
 if moduleMode {
  calls:=0
  unexpected:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{calls++;return js.Undefined()})
  defer unexpected.Release()
  offlineNativeTestClaimSlot(t,unexpected.Value)
  if claimOfflineNativeCapability().valid || calls!=0 {t.Fatal("module consumed eager-core claim")}
  return
 }
 // An ordinary native Object.defineProperty call with a primitive target throws
 // without invoking a Go callback panic. No eval/Function constructor is used.
 g:=js.Global()
 object:=checkedJSGet(g,"Object")
 bound:=checkedJSCall(checkedJSGet(object,"defineProperty"),"bind",js.Undefined(),1,"x",checkedJSObject(map[string]any{}))
 offlineNativeTestClaimSlot(t,bound)
 if claimOfflineNativeCapability().valid {t.Fatal("throwing claim became supported")}
}
func TestOfflineNativeMalformedClaimIsOptional(t *testing.T) {
 callback:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{return checkedJSObject(map[string]any{"version":1,"supported":true,"prepare":js.Null()})})
 defer callback.Release()
 offlineNativeTestClaimSlot(t,callback.Value)
 if claimOfflineNativeCapability().valid {t.Fatal("partial capability became supported")}
}

func TestOfflineNativeUnavailableHelpersDoNotPanic(t *testing.T) {
 held:=offlineNativeFacet
 offlineNativeFacet=offlineNativeCapability{}
 defer func(){offlineNativeFacet=held}()
 if offlineNativeReady() {t.Fatal("unavailable facet reported ready")}
 if _,err:=offlineNativeCreateFrame(js.Undefined(),"https://example.invalid/helper");err!=ErrOfflineUnsupported {t.Fatal("frame support did not refuse locally")}
 if _,err:=offlineNativeCaptureParent(js.Undefined(),js.Undefined());err!=ErrOfflineUnsupported {t.Fatal("parent support did not refuse locally")}
 if _,err:=offlineNativeCreateChannel();err!=ErrOfflineUnsupported {t.Fatal("channel support did not refuse locally")}
 if _,err:=offlineNativeInspectInventory(js.Undefined());err!=ErrOfflineUnsupported {t.Fatal("inventory support did not refuse locally")}
 if _,err:=offlineNativePrepare(offlineNativeInput{});err!=ErrOfflineUnsupported {t.Fatal("prepare support did not refuse locally")}
 _=OfflineStatus() // Ordinary public status remains callable without this facet.
}
func TestOfflineNativeReceiptRejectsUnknownTags(t *testing.T) {
 // TESTONLY decoder model: it grants no capability/native brand or dispatch.
 cases:=[]struct{name string;reason any;entered any}{
  {"unknown reason",9,true},{"fractional reason",1.5,true},{"wrong entered tag",0,1},
 }
 for _,tc:=range cases {t.Run(tc.name,func(t *testing.T){
  read:=js.FuncOf(func(js.Value,[]js.Value)any{return checkedJSArray([]any{1,"test",int(offlineNativeChildList),tc.entered,tc.reason,false,false,js.Undefined()})})
  defer read.Release()
  call:=&offlineNativeCall{read:read.Value,nonce:"test",operation:offlineNativeChildList}
  if _,err:=call.readReceipt();err==nil {t.Fatal("malformed receipt accepted")}
 })}
}


func TestOfflineNativeInventoryDecoderKeepsNullSlotsDistinct(t *testing.T) {
 // TESTONLY private snapshot decoder model; no platform brand assertion.
 registration:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{})
 worker:=checkedJSObject(map[string]any{})
 cases:=[]struct{name string;active,waiting,installing js.Value;au,wu,iu string;valid bool}{
  {"all null",js.Null(),js.Null(),js.Null(),"","","",true},
  {"active only",worker,js.Null(),js.Null(),"https://example.invalid/sw.js","","",true},
  {"waiting only",js.Null(),worker,js.Null(),"","https://example.invalid/sw.js","",true},
  {"undefined active",js.Undefined(),js.Null(),js.Null(),"","","",false},
  {"undefined waiting",worker,js.Undefined(),js.Null(),"https://example.invalid/sw.js","","",false},
  {"null url mismatch",js.Null(),js.Null(),js.Null(),"https://example.invalid/sw.js","","",false},
  {"object missing url",worker,js.Null(),js.Null(),"","","",false},
 }
 for _,tc:=range cases {t.Run(tc.name,func(t *testing.T){
  row:=checkedJSArray([]any{registration,"https://example.invalid/",tc.active,tc.waiting,tc.installing,tc.au,tc.wu,tc.iu})
  result,err:=offlineNativeDecodeInventory(checkedJSArray([]any{row}))
  if (err==nil)!=tc.valid {t.Fatalf("valid=%v, error=%v",tc.valid,err)}
  if tc.valid && (len(result)!=1 || !result[0].Active.Equal(tc.active) || !result[0].Waiting.Equal(tc.waiting) || !result[0].Installing.Equal(tc.installing)) {t.Fatal("native slot identity/null was lost")}
 })}
}

func TestOfflineNativeInventoryDecoderRejectsMissingAndOversizedRows(t *testing.T) {
 for _,size:=range []int{65,66} {
  if _,err:=offlineNativeDecodeInventory(checkedJSArray(make([]any,size)));err==nil {t.Fatal("oversized inventory accepted")}
 }
 row:=checkedJSArray([]any{checkedJSObject(map[string]any{}),"https://example.invalid/",js.Null(),js.Null(),js.Null(),"",""})
 if _,err:=offlineNativeDecodeInventory(checkedJSArray([]any{row}));err==nil {t.Fatal("partial inventory row accepted")}
}
